task: For each prompt, a gold continuation of 8-20 tokens is given. At every step there are 3 candidate next tokens forming a soft-label distribution; candidates[0] is the boosted best prediction and always equals 'chosen'.

conventions: A token is a sub-word unit, NOT necessarily a word. Punctuation is usually its own token.
A token that begins a new word carries a leading space, e.g. ' two'; 'two' without the space would be a different token.
Code snippets preserve exact symbols and casing; brackets, quotes and operators are separate tokens.
Long numbers and some identifiers can split into 2+ sub-tokens under real tokenizers; they are written as single tokens here for readability.
tokenization.caveat: Probabilities are heuristic prior estimates (soft teaching targets), not measured corpus frequencies. Re-encode every token with your model's own tokenizer before training; if a token splits, merge the step or distribute its mass to the first sub-token.

how_to_use: context(step i) = prompt + ''.join(chosen tokens of steps 1..i-1)
Train with KL/CE against the 3-way soft distribution per step, or use candidates[0] as a hard target.
The determinism field buckets steps by confidence: deterministic / high / medium / open.
Categories 1-50: user prompts; 51-150: general SLM grounding; 151-200: code explanation.
